question:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Timid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Timid"** means showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened. (डरपोक)

 
 
• **Example: **She was too** timid **to ask for what she wanted.
 
 
 
• **"Daring" **refers to being adventurous or bold; showing courage. (साहसी)
 
 
• **Example: **His **daring** rescue of the child from the burning building was commendable.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'timid' **is **'daring'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Meek** (नम्र): Quiet, gentle, and easily imposed on; submissive.

 
 
• **Example:** He was always meek and never stood up for himself.
 
 
 
• **Anxious** (चिंतित): Experiencing worry, unease, or nervousness.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt anxious before the big presentation.
 
 
 
• **Spooky** (डरावना): Sinister or ghostly in a way that causes fear and unease.
 
 
• **Example:** The abandoned house looked spooky at night.
